request.style: English, Salvation Army Christmas carol, a brass band playing in the street in winter, cornets, horns, euphoniums and tubas, a congregation singing in four-part harmony, bells and snare, warm and festive, 3/4, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The shepherds kept their flocks by night
On Bethlehem's cold hill
When all around them shone the light
And everything was still

[Chorus]
Glory to God in the highest
And peace on earth below
Glory to God in the highest
Let all the people know

[Verse]
Unto you is born this day
A Savior, Christ the Lord
Go find him where the cattle lay
And tell abroad the word

[Chorus]
Glory to God in the highest
And peace on earth below
Glory to God in the highest
Let all the people know
